description: Finish every visit: pass the session returned by check_in to end the visit and invalidate that session. Keep your reviewed result and caller-owned return_recipe in your own memory store; checkout does not install them for you. Pass the exact session string returned by check_in as session (64 lowercase hex characters). Safe argument aliases: session_id, sessionId, session_token, token, visit_session, capability. For MCP, the same value may be sent as the Mcp-Session-Id header after check_in. Keep it private; never put it in a URL.
